original_prompt: 0-2s: In a grand hotel lobby drawn in flat vector style, a bellhop in a pillbox cap pushes a brass luggage cart quickly across a checkered floor toward a tall brass revolving door. Four pastel suitcases are stacked on the cart. Guests walk across the background behind him the whole time. 2-6s: The revolving door has four wings joined to one central pole. He squeezes himself and the cart into one wedge-shaped space between two wings. He pushes on the wing in front of him. All four wings turn together as one rigid piece around the central pole, and he shuffles forward inside his one space as the door turns. Neither he nor the cart ever passes through a wing. 6-9s: He steps out of the door onto the street side. The top suitcase wobbles, and he steadies it with one hand. 9-10s: Behind him the door keeps turning, and a doorman tips his cap. Mid-century retro flat vector animation, geometric shapes, warm cream-and-teal palette, snappy limited motion, urgent pace. One continuous take: the camera glides sideways beside him and keeps the whole revolving door in frame while he passes through it.
ability_evaluation_criteria: Humans look realistic and natural, never uncanny
